title: A Field for Tomorrow
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who does the brave thing before he can see why, and tonight Jeremiah buys a field with the Babylonian army outside the walls because Heavenly Father promised the land would be lived in again, the way Beau waters a seed in a paper cup every morning before anything shows.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because doing the brave thing before you can see why is his kind of courage. In Beau’s world today: he plants one tiny seed in a paper cup, and nothing happens for days. He waters it every morning anyway, even when the dirt still looks empty. Just like Jeremiah buying a field in a hard year, Beau learned that faith means doing good things before you see them grow.
